sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Kruglov's RFID keycard (Kruglov) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A personalized RFID card with a strict design. Grants access to the TerraGroup evacuation point reserved for trusted personnel.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter The Ticket

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: - Acquired by unpacking the Armored case after progressing through the story chapter The Ticket.
